timing.method: Fresh process per pass; sealed baseline/current packed modules imported separately. Both use SIMD. Each image/effort pair receives alternating variant calls, with the starting order reversed in pass two. Warmup calls are recorded separately. Timed intervals contain synchronous encode only; input loading, hashing, validation and receipt writes are excluded. Process CPU includes runtime background threads and can cross paired call boundaries. No profiler, forced GC, timing rejection or outlier removal. Peak RSS is cumulative for the shared process and cannot be attributed to a variant.
timing.aggregation: Geometric mean of the five per-image pooled-median current/baseline ratios. All six measured samples per variant and case are included; warmups are recorded separately.
